newsitem.title: USA: Gardner Denver sees Q3 EPS above estimate.
newsitem.headline: Gardner Denver sees Q3 EPS above estimate.

text.p: Gardner Denver Machinery Inc said Thursday it expected third quarter earnings to significantly exceed analysts' estimates of $0.55-$0.57 a share.
The company reported net income of $0.38 a share in the year-ago quarter.

Gardner Denver, a manufacturer of air compressor and blower products for various industrial applications and pumps used in oil and gas production and well servicing, drilling and stimulation, said it will report third quarter earnings October 30.
The stock was halted at 29-1/2, down 3/8, pending news dissemination Thursday.
